packageRules.description: Digest, patch, and minor image updates auto-merge after the app version bump and lint. The App version workflow merges the PR only when those checks are green and no review thread from jonbeckman, Bugbot, or a lint/format bot is open. platformAutomerge arms GitHub auto-merge; branch protection must require the version-bump check so this cannot merge before that bump commit.
Major image updates stay for a person to merge.
Images this repo builds are pinned by CI, not by Renovate.
Action digest, patch, and minor updates auto-merge on the same terms as image updates. They do not change an app version.
Major GitHub Action updates stay for a person to merge.
